narration.text: Only 5 AI tools are worth your time for YouTube.
Coming in at number five, Pictory. This tool quickly turns text into basic video, perfect for news updates or simple listicles. It is a solid choice to get started creating content fast.
Number four is Murf AI. If you need realistic voiceovers without hiring anyone, Murf delivers. Its range of voices and languages makes your channel sound truly professional.
At number three, Opus Clip. This smart tool automatically cuts your long videos into viral Shorts. It is brilliant for repurposing content and reaching new audiences on different platforms.
Runner-up at number two, ChatGPT. The free version alone can brainstorm endless video ideas, write full scripts, and help with research. It is a massive time-saver for any creator.
And the top spot goes to Midjourney. For stunning, unique visuals that grab attention, nothing else compares. It elevates your faceless videos from good to absolutely captivating.
Midjourney is simply the best for a faceless channel. What AI tool do you think should be on this list?
